subject: Move the holdout census and the ladder records off the public repo
description: A sweep on 2026-11-03 found that docs/experiments/nfi_multiyear_holdout_census_20261012.json, served by Pages since 2026-10-12, names 273 real holdout tiles (exact 5.12 km footprints, 208 of them holding NFI plots), and that the rung-ablation ladder records (ladder_miou_v2_2026-10-13.md, ladder_miou_v2_20261013.json, ladder_distill_stage.md) publish paper results. Tobias decided: remove the census from main with a private copy first and extend the tile guard to holdoutval_ names, without a history rewrite; and make the ladder files private. Private copies: TobiasEdman/imintengine-experiments PR #2. Scope: remove the four files, repoint references to private pointers, extend test_no_nfi_tile_locations_tracked, move test fixtures outside Sweden's tile range, regenerate the ladder manifests' plan line. Not in scope: git history rewrite, GitHub Support, the SLU notice (Tobias), other result files Tobias chose to keep public. Review: Codex.
